caseNameFull: Walter S. Scott v. Augustus L. Abbott, Trustee, etc.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit denied. Mr. Joseph S. Laurie *572and Mr. Frederick N. Judson for petitioners. Mr. Lee W. . Grant, Mr. B. Schnurmacher, Mr. Leo Rassieur and Mr. B. P. Kennedy for the respondent.
